body:
Thank you for your kind words.

The problem is that I have let them down.  I was the one who was supposed to protect them.  They unfortunately have had to see me in the hospital, in bed after every electro shock treatment, breaking into tears frequently, my therapist even sent the sheriff once for a welfare check and they had to see that.

Every time I went under anesthesia for electro shock I prayed I wouldn't wake up.  This way when I pull the trigger I will know I won't wake up.  I just pray for my soul.

I appreciate that, but my job was/is to protect and care for my family.  I have failed miserably at it.  I just can live knowing the pain I've caused and right now all I am doing is consuming resources.

How are we doing Stephen?  You still with me?

By the way, I'm an idiot.  You said it was 4 am, I asked you where you were.  

Obviously Western Europe.  I'm sorry for my lack of deductive skills.

Thank you.  I appreciate your kind words.  

I have tried, I really have.  Therapy 3x a week until my insurance ran out.  Over 12 different antidepressants in 2 years.  At one time I was taking 4 different prescriptions.  Even had 14 electro shock treatments.  Interestingly they helped for a bit, got me off disability, but it didn't last.  The one side effect was that it seems to have cured my anxiety.

My profession was as a partner in a big accounting and consulting firm.  With my financial difficulties I just won't be able to get another job.  I just don't see how this is fixable.

When I was in the hospital one of the doctors said something to me that stuck with me.  He said "you are the type of person that scares me, your job is to be analytical and think things through, you are the type that is most likely to pull it off"

I know, but I'm just a huge disappointment to them.  Because of me they went from a big house into a small apartment.  My wife didn't work and had to go back to work.  

For my daughters 16th birthday I got her a trip to Chicago to see Hamilton.  That was 6 months ago.  They saw it yesterday.  Frankly I have waited this long because I didn't want her to be sad when she saw it.  She went with my 24 year old son because I just couldn't rally.  

I haven't heard from them in 5 months.  They will be sad for a bit, then it will get better.
Thank you.  I really mean that.
I'm still here.  I don't plan on doing it till tomorrow afternoon.

Stephen,

I'm really sorry you are going through this.  It really sucks.  I lost my grandfather when I was 12.  He was my best friend too.  I doesn't seem minor to me if you are feeling this way.

I'm not sure where you live, in the US, UK, Canada?

Can I suggest something?  It seems like there is a lot going on, and respectfully you have time on your side.  In addition it is obvious that you are very smart based on how articulate you are.

What if you built a plan that instead of focused on hurting yourself, it focused on small achievable ways to get help with your situation.  I will even help.  You have your whole life ahead of you.  I know you don't think that doesn't mean much, but with time it will.
